items.title: TransDigm (TDG) Stock Looks Undervalued Despite Mixed Broader Checks
items.summary: TransDigm Group stock has pulled back from recent highs, yet the current price sits below an intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model, which points to a sizeable valuation gap. At the same time, broader checks paint a mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or clear overvaluation.
